description_en: Queries the run records of a created node by Name with paging. The JobRunId in each record is active for retrieving the results of a specific run, and the ExecutorJobId is active for querying details, retrieving logs, or stopping the run
description_zh: 按已创建任务的 Name 分页查询其运行记录；记录中的 JobRunId 可用于获取指定运行的结果，ExecutorJobId 可用于详情、日志与停止
name: ListSemanticJobRuns

parameters.help_en: The job name. Use the Data.Name value from the CreateSemanticJob response or the Name value from a ListSemanticJobs list item
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应的 Data.Name 或 ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 Name
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. If this parameter is not specified or set to a value less than or equal to 0, page 1 is returned
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始；省略或小于等于 0 时按第 1 页处理
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of run records to return per page. If this parameter is not specified or set to a value less than or equal to 0, the default value 50 is used. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的运行记录数；省略或小于等于 0 时默认 50，最大 200
parameters.name: page_size

schema.description_en: The standard response for paging query of run records. Each item in Data.JobRuns corresponds to a committed run
schema.description_zh: 分页查询运行记录的标准响应。Data.JobRuns 中每项对应一次已提交运行

Data.description_en: The paginated run record results. Use the JobRunId to download the results of a specific run, and use the ExecutorJobId to query details, retrieve logs, or stop a run
Data.description_zh: 运行记录分页结果。使用其中的 JobRunId 下载指定运行结果，使用 ExecutorJobId 查询详情、日志或停止运行

items.description_en: The record of a single semantic job run
items.description_zh: 一次语义任务运行的记录

ExecutorJobId.description_en: The executor job ID. Pass this value as the ExecutorJobId parameter to GetSemanticJobDetail, GetSemanticJobLog, or KillSemanticJob
ExecutorJobId.description_zh: 执行器任务标识；传给 GetSemanticJobDetail、GetSemanticJobLog 或 KillSemanticJob 的 ExecutorJobId

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the run record was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 运行记录创建时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳

JobName.description_en: The name of the job to which this run belongs. You can use this value to rerun the job, query run records, or download results
JobName.description_zh: 运行所属任务名称；可用于再次运行、查询运行记录或下载结果

JobRunId.description_en: The semantic job run ID. Pass this value as the JobRunId parameter to DownloadSemanticResults to download the results of this run
JobRunId.description_zh: 语义任务运行标识；传给 DownloadSemanticResults 的 JobRunId 可下载该次运行结果

UserId.description_en: The ID of the user who submitted this run
UserId.description_zh: 提交本次运行的用户标识

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page, starting from 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 本次返回的页码，从 1 开始

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page in the current response
PageSize.description_zh: 本次返回的每页记录数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of run records that match the current job criteria
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前任务条件的运行记录总数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
